summary: A candidate steps aside days after an endorsement, saying she wants the campaign to run without constant defense, and backs whoever the party picks.
realLife: After a county party endorsed her and online attacks followed, a council candidate withdrew, said she did not want a cloud over the campaign, and said she might run again within two years.
sources: The Philadelphia Inquirer, county council candidate withdraws days after endorsement, Feb. 24, 2025: https://www.inquirer.com/politics/election/tasliym-morales-withdraws-delco-county-council-republican-candidate-20250224.html
inGame: party endorsement record; withdrawal; the next endorsement vote

turns.turn: She leaves and says she will run again
